save_state_checkpoint: save model training state including optimizer, scheduler, and extra state to a checkpoint file
load_model_state: load model parameters and optimizer state from a checkpoint file into a model
load_ensemble_for_inference: load an ensemble of models from multiple checkpoint files for inference with optional argument overrides
parse_embedding_file: parse a text file of word embeddings into a dictionary mapping tokens to embedding tensors
retrieve_checkpoint_paths: retrieve all checkpoint files from a directory matching a regex pattern sorted by version descending
